beats.subline: Friday, August 7, 2026 close — stocks rallied to a record finish, capping the S&P 500's best week since April.
beats.body: The S&P 500 closed at a record high and the Nasdaq jumped more than 1% after the Labor Department reported the U.S. economy lost 23,000 jobs in July while unemployment held at 4.1%, reducing expectations of a Federal Reserve rate hike next month; the S&P gained 3.6% and the Nasdaq 5.2% on the week.

beats.headline: Saudi Arabia, Turkey and Pakistan sign mutual-defense pact amid Iran war
beats.body: The three countries signed the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement on Friday, committing to treat an attack on any one of them as an attack on all three; the pact combines Turkey's military strength, Saudi oil wealth and Pakistan's nuclear deterrent into a new regional security bloc as Gulf states continue absorbing missile and drone attacks tied to the ongoing Iran war.

beats.headline: Taiwan moves to dissolve pro-Beijing party over alleged CCP infiltration
beats.body: Taiwan's Ministry of the Interior petitioned the Constitutional Court on Friday to dissolve the Chinese Unification Promotion Party, the first such action against a political party in Taiwan's history, citing alleged recruitment of active-duty and retired military personnel into a Beijing-directed espionage network among other national-security violations.

beats.headline: US military has burned through 80% of THAAD interceptor stock in Iran war
beats.body: The Pentagon has expended roughly 80% of its THAAD interceptor inventory and about half its Patriot interceptors since the Iran war began, prompting President Trump to order investigations into who leaked the stockpile figures even as he publicly insisted the US has 'massive amounts' of munitions to continue the fight.

beats.headline: Marine Corps runs first field tests of Perennial Autonomy's drone family
beats.body: The 2nd Marine Division's Unmanned Systems Center of Excellence ran several days of integrated field training at Twentynine Palms with startup Perennial Autonomy's Bumblebee quadcopter, Hornet strike drone and AS-3 Merops interceptor, its first hands-on work with the company, as the newly stood-up Marine Corps Robotics Integration Group builds out service-wide drone training standards.

beats.headline: Anthropic opens self-hosted environments beta for Claude Code
beats.body: Anthropic launched a public beta letting Claude Code run sessions on infrastructure organizations control themselves rather than Anthropic's cloud, keeping repository checkouts, secrets and build artifacts inside the customer's network while model inference still runs through Anthropic; the option targets Team and Enterprise customers with strict compliance or network requirements and is off by default.

beats.headline: Bears sign veteran safety Xavier Woods, place Dallis Flowers on injured reserve
beats.body: Chicago signed 31-year-old safety Xavier Woods, who has 121 career starts and started 10 games for Tennessee last season, after cornerback Dallis Flowers needed help leaving Thursday's practice with a right leg injury and was placed on injured reserve.
